description.value: Sip of Life is a family-owned coffee house on West Broadway in Vancouver, offering a full range of espresso drinks, brewed coffee, frappes, smoothies, and a tea bar alongside non-coffee options. The café emphasizes sustainability through locally-sourced organic ingredients and eco-friendly practices, with a plant-adorned interior intended as a community gathering spot. It sits on a busy commercial corridor well-travelled by cyclists crossing the city.
